app_review_info.notes:
Thank you for reviewing Pausely.

Sign in with the review account in the App Review Information fields, with Sign in with Apple, or tap "Continue without an account" to test locally on-device.

WHAT TO TRY
1. Add a subscription from the catalog (+ button) or import a screenshot on-device. Pausely then offers to turn on renewal reminders.
2. Open a subscription that renews within 3 days to see the Renewal Verdict (keep it or cancel it). Tapping a reminder opens the same screen.
3. Cancel one with "I cancelled it": it stays in the list as cancelled and appears on the Savings Receipt (Profile > Savings Receipt) and the Savings Receipt widget.
4. Pausely Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: $4.99/month or $29.99/year, with a 7-day free trial. It unlocks unlimited subscriptions, Pause Plan (Insights tab, with live rotation controls and sync), 12-month forecast and cut simulator (Insights tab), batch screenshot import (up to 10 at once), and cancellation & refund email drafts. Restore Purchases is on the paywall. Reminders, Renewal Verdicts, cancel help, overview Insights and the Savings Receipt are free.
5. Account deletion: Profile > Privacy & Security > Delete Account. It deletes the account and its data from our servers and from the device.

Pausely does not cancel subscriptions for anyone; it shows the steps and links to each service's own cancellation page. Email import (Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP) is turned off in this build.

Contact: pausely@proton.me
